operator_language: Use plain notation names. Never expose quarter-unit abbreviations such as q in human_summary or questions. Red means a region has one or more named frame landmarks to verify; blue means it was directly checked and is a normal bar with none.

geometry_assist.instructions: Use the skeleton and barline evidence to prioritize inspection. Confirm every final boundary against the printed crop. Candidate geometry may be accepted, adjusted, or rejected; never pass from model confidence or agreement alone.
